text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Bright. It was you, right? Did you 
leave that doll on my desk?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~! It's a birthday present for dearest 
Ryan! I made it myself~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...! Thank you. Um, it really 
made me so happy... It's such a cute doll.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... I was actually interested. 
I just had no idea how to go about 
collecting them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, that short-haired doll... I 
feel like it looks like someone I know..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, did you notice? I actually made it 
to look like dear sister Ryan~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a doll to celebrate a special 
birthday, I wanted to make it extra 
special~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that... me!? ...Me, wearing a dress 
with ruffled sleeves...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Along with the brighter ones, I've also 
been making some darker-toned dresses~. 
I'll bring them over to your room next 
time~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Another dress...!? Ah, geez, that kind of 
thing really isn't for me—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but a doll's dress, huh... Then, 
maybe... it's fine... for me to wear it. 
Considering the doll, it might actually 
be...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
We should definitely dress her up in more 
stuff! Thanks, Bright! I can't wait for 
the next dress!
